Avval ega va asosiy fe’lni toping. Har bir gap uchun «kim/nima — nima qildi?» savolini bering. So‘ng bitta muhim sabab yoki tafsilotni qo‘shing.

examples.en: By stating that its market value changed during the year, the writer introduces an idea for the reader to examine.
examples.uz: Muallif “Yil davomida uning bozor qiymati o‘zgardi” deb, o‘quvchi tekshirishi uchun bir fikrni taqdim etadi.

examples.en: The reader should assess the suggestion that the brands used different marketing strategies.
examples.uz: O‘quvchi “Brendlar turli marketing strategiyalaridan foydalandi” degan fikrni baholashi kerak.

examples.en: The source gives an example, not a universal rule.
examples.uz: Manba umumiy qoida emas, bir misol beradi.

examples.en: This statement refers to the situation at that time.
examples.uz: Bu bayonot o‘sha paytdagi vaziyatga tegishli.

examples.en: The evidence does not support that conclusion.
examples.uz: Dalil bu xulosani tasdiqlamaydi.

entries.tipUz: Quyidagi misollar RIWI uchun yangi tuzilgan. Ular maqoladan iqtibos emas va undagi tarixiy voqealarni tasdiqlamaydi.
entries.tipEn: These examples were written for RIWI. They are not quotations or verification of the article’s historical claims.
entries.practiceUz: Darajangizdagi matndan bitta fikr tanlang. Uni sodda qilib qayta ayting, dalil jumlasini va fikr kimga tegishli ekanini ko‘rsating.
entries.practiceEn: Choose one point from your level of the article. Paraphrase it, locate the evidence and identify whose claim it is.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 1: Present tenses
entries.explanationUz: Present simple odat va holatni, present continuous vaqtinchalik yoki ayni paytdagi jarayonni ko‘rsatadi. Think «fikrda bo‘lmoq» ma’nosida holat, «o‘ylab ko‘rmoq» ma’nosida jarayon bo‘lishi mumkin. Shaklni signal so‘zga qarabgina emas, shu ma’noga qarab tanlang.
entries.explanationEn: Use the present simple for habits and states, and the present continuous for ongoing or temporary situations. A verb such as think can describe a state or an activity depending on its meaning.

examples.en: I think the explanation is clear.
examples.uz: Menimcha, tushuntirish aniq.

examples.en: I am thinking about a new study plan.
examples.uz: Men yangi o‘qish rejasi haqida o‘ylayapman.

examples.en: She usually studies at home, but this week she is using the library.
examples.uz: U odatda uyda o‘qiydi, lekin bu hafta kutubxonadan foydalanyapti.

examples.en: I read every evening.
examples.uz: Men har oqshom kitob o‘qiyman.

examples.en: She reads before bed.
examples.uz: U uxlashdan oldin kitob o‘qiydi.

examples.en: Does she read at home?
examples.uz: U uyda kitob o‘qiydimi?

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 2: Past tenses 1
entries.explanationUz: Past simple tugagan hodisani, past continuous o‘sha paytda davom etayotgan jarayonni beradi. Used to eski odat yoki avvalgi holatni tasvirlay oladi. Would takroriy harakat uchun ishlatiladi, lekin «avval bir uyim bor edi» kabi oddiy eski holat uchun odatda used to tanlanadi.
entries.explanationEn: Use the past simple for completed events and the past continuous for background activities. Used to can describe past habits or states; habitual would usually describes repeated actions rather than states.

examples.en: I was taking notes when the lesson ended.
examples.uz: Dars tugaganida men qaydlar yozayotgan edim.

examples.en: Every Friday, our teacher would give us a short quiz.

examples.en: I was reading at eight.
examples.uz: Men soat sakkizda kitob o‘qiyotgan edim.

examples.en: She was cooking when I arrived.
examples.uz: Men kelganimda u ovqat pishirayotgan edi.

examples.en: They were playing while we were studying.
examples.uz: Biz o‘qiyotganimizda ular o‘ynayotgan edi.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 3: Present perfect
entries.explanationUz: Present perfect simple ko‘pincha natija yoki nechta ish tugaganiga urg‘u beradi. Continuous esa jarayon va qancha vaqt davom etganini ko‘rsatadi. I have read three pages — uch sahifa o‘qib bo‘lingan; I have been reading — o‘qish jarayoniga urg‘u. Holat fe’llari bilan continuous har doim ham mos kelmaydi.
entries.explanationEn: The simple form often highlights a completed result or quantity; the continuous form highlights activity or duration up to now. State verbs do not generally take continuous forms in their state meaning.

examples.en: I have known my study partner for three years.

examples.uz: Men bir soatdan beri o‘qiyapman.

examples.en: She has been working here since May.
examples.uz: U may oyidan beri shu yerda ishlab kelmoqda.

examples.en: It has been raining all morning.
examples.uz: Ertalabdan beri yomg‘ir yog‘moqda.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 4: Past tenses 2
entries.explanationUz: Past perfect hikoyadagi boshqa o‘tgan nuqtadan oldingi ishni ko‘rsatadi. Past perfect continuous shu oldingi nuqtagacha davom etgan jarayonni ta’kidlaydi. Voqealar tartibi allaqachon aniq bo‘lsa, har bir oldingi harakatni majburan past perfect qilish shart emas.
entries.explanationEn: The past perfect places an event before another past reference point. The continuous form focuses on an activity continuing up to that point. Do not use the past perfect mechanically for every earlier event.

examples.en: By the time I arrived, the class had started.
examples.uz: Men yetib kelgunimcha dars boshlanib bo‘lgan edi.

examples.en: She had been practising for an hour when I called.
examples.uz: Men qo‘ng‘iroq qilganimda u bir soatdan beri mashq qilayotgan edi.

examples.en: I felt prepared because I had reviewed my mistakes.
examples.uz: Xatolarimni ko‘rib chiqqanim uchun o‘zimni tayyor his qildim.

examples.en: The bus had left when I arrived.
examples.uz: Men kelganimda avtobus ketib bo‘lgan edi.

examples.en: She had finished before dinner.
examples.uz: U kechki ovqatdan oldin tugatib bo‘lgan edi.

examples.en: We had never met before that day.
examples.uz: Biz o‘sha kungacha hech uchrashmagan edik.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 5: Future 1
entries.explanationUz: Kelajakni aytishning bir nechta usuli bor. Present continuous kelishilgan reja uchun, going to avvalgi niyat yoki hozirgi dalilga asoslangan taxmin uchun ishlatilishi mumkin. Will ko‘pincha shu zahotiy qaror, va’da yoki taxminni beradi. Bu shakllar ba’zan bir-biriga yaqin ma’no ham beradi.
entries.explanationEn: Present continuous can describe arrangements, going to can express intentions or predictions based on present evidence, and will can express decisions, promises or predictions. The forms sometimes overlap; choose the meaning you need.

examples.uz: Ertaga soat to‘rtda ustozim bilan uchrashaman.

examples.en: I am going to study tonight.

examples.en: We are meeting the tutor at six.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 6: Future 2
entries.explanationUz: Jadvaldagi kelajak voqeasi present simple bilan berilishi mumkin. Future continuous kelajakdagi bir paytda davom etayotgan ishni ko‘rsatadi. Future perfect esa kelajakdagi muddatgacha tugagan natijani bildiradi. By odatda muddat chegarasi, at esa aniq paytni ko‘rsatadi.
entries.explanationEn: Use the present simple for scheduled events, the future continuous for an activity in progress at a future time, and the future perfect for a result completed by a future deadline.

examples.en: The workshop starts at nine tomorrow.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 7: Countable and uncountable nouns
entries.explanationUz: Sanaladigan otning birlik shakliga ko‘pincha a/an yoki boshqa aniqlovchi kerak. Advice, information kabi sanalmaydigan otlarni odatda -s bilan ko‘paytirmaymiz: a piece of advice deyish mumkin. Few — deyarli yetarli emas, a few — oz bo‘lsa ham bir nechta; little va a little ham shu ma’no farqini sanalmaydigan ot bilan beradi.
entries.explanationEn: A singular countable noun normally needs a determiner. Uncountable nouns such as advice and information do not normally take plural -s. Few/little suggest a shortage; a few/a little indicate some available quantity.

examples.en: I need a piece of advice about revision.
examples.uz: Takrorlash bo‘yicha bir maslahat kerak.

examples.en: We have a few minutes before class.
examples.uz: Darsgacha bir necha daqiqamiz bor.

examples.en: There is little information about the source.
examples.uz: Manba haqida ma’lumot juda kam.

examples.en: I have a few friends here.
examples.uz: Bu yerda bir nechta do‘stim bor. Oz bo‘lsa ham borligiga urg‘u berilgan.

examples.en: I have few friends here.
examples.uz: Bu yerda do‘stlarim juda kam. Yetishmaslik seziladi.

examples.en: We have a little time.
examples.uz: Bizda biroz vaqt bor.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 8: Referring to nouns
entries.explanationUz: A/an hali aniq tanishtirilmagan bitta narsani, the suhbatdosh aniqlay oladigan narsani bildiradi. Each va every odatda birlik sanaladigan ot bilan keladi. Both ikki narsaning ikkalasini, all esa guruhning barchasini bildiradi. Artikllarni faqat tarjimaga qarab emas, o‘quvchi qaysi narsani taniy olishiga qarab tanlang.
entries.explanationEn: A/an introduces a nonspecific singular item; the marks an identifiable referent. Each/every normally take a singular countable noun. Both refers to two; all refers to the whole relevant group.

examples.en: I found an example, and the example helped me.
examples.uz: Bir misol topdim va o‘sha misol menga yordam berdi.

examples.en: Each student has a notebook.

examples.en: The book is on my desk.
examples.uz: O‘sha kitob stolim ustida. Endi qaysi kitobligi ma’lum.

examples.en: She waited for an hour.
examples.uz: U bir soat kutdi. Hour unli tovush bilan boshlanadi.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 9: Pronouns and referencing
entries.explanationUz: Olmosh takrorni kamaytiradi, lekin u qaysi otga tegishli ekanini o‘quvchi bilishi kerak. He, she yoki it ikkita narsaga tegishli bo‘lib qolsa, otni qayta yozing. Reflexive olmosh ish egasiga qaytishini ko‘rsatadi: herself — o‘zi uchun yoki o‘zi tomonidan.
entries.explanationEn: Pronouns reduce repetition only when their reference is clear. Repeat the noun if a pronoun could refer to two different people or things. Reflexive forms refer back to the relevant subject.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 10: Adjectives and adverbs
entries.explanationUz: Adjective otni yoki linking verbdan keyin egani tasvirlaydi; adverb ko‘pincha harakat qanday bajarilganini bildiradi. Hard va hardly bir xil emas: hard — astoydil, hardly — deyarli yo‘q. Always kabi chastota so‘zining gapdagi o‘rni ham ma’noga va fe’l tuzilishiga mos bo‘lsin.
entries.explanationEn: Adjectives describe nouns or subjects after linking verbs; adverbs often describe how an action is done. Hard and hardly have different meanings. Adverb position depends on the verb structure and intended focus.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 11: Comparing things
entries.explanationUz: Comparative ikki narsa yoki ikki holatni solishtiradi: easier than. Superlative guruh ichidagi eng yuqori darajani bildiradi. As ... as tenglikni beradi. Farqning miqdori bo‘lsa, undan foydalaning; more better kabi ikki marta qiyos yasamang. Taqqoslashning ikkala tomoni bir turdagi ko‘rsatkich bo‘lsin.
entries.explanationEn: Comparatives compare items or situations; superlatives identify an extreme within a group. As ... as expresses equality. Avoid double comparison such as more better, and compare like quantities or categories.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 12: The noun phrase
entries.explanationUz: Uzun noun phrase ichidan avval bosh otni toping. Keyingi of, with yoki -ing bilan kelgan qismlar uni aniqlashi mumkin. Kesimni eng yaqin ot bilan emas, butun ega guruhining bosh oti bilan moslang. Students waiting outside birikmasida waiting outside «tashqarida kutayotgan» degan qo‘shimcha ma’lumot.
entries.explanationEn: Find the head noun inside a long noun phrase. Following prepositional, participle or infinitive phrases may modify it. Match the main verb to the head of the subject phrase, not simply the nearest noun.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 13: Modals 1
entries.explanationUz: Modal fe’ldan keyin odatda fe’lning asosiy shakli keladi: can explain. Umumiy o‘tgan qobiliyat uchun could, bir safardagi muvaffaqiyatli natija uchun ko‘pincha was able to yoki managed to mos. Bu mutlaq taqiq emas: see va hear kabi ayrim fe’llarda could bir martalik holatda ham ishlatiladi.
entries.explanationEn: A modal is normally followed by the base verb. Could describes general past ability; was able to or managed to often highlights a particular successful achievement. This is not an absolute ban on could in one-off situations, especially with perception verbs.

examples.uz: Asosiy fikrni tushuntira olaman.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 14: Modals 2
entries.explanationUz: Mustn’t taqiqni bildiradi: qilish mumkin emas. Don’t have to va needn’t esa majburiyat yo‘qligini bildiradi: qilish shart emas, ammo mumkin. O‘tgan yoki kelajakdagi majburiyat uchun had to yoki will have to ishlatilishi mumkin. Needn’t have done odatda qilingan ish aslida kerak bo‘lmaganini bildiradi.
entries.explanationEn: Mustn’t expresses prohibition. Don’t have to and needn’t express lack of necessity, not a ban. Had to/will have to can express past/future obligation. Needn’t have done normally refers to an action that happened unnecessarily.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 15: Reported speech
entries.explanationUz: Boshqaning gapini yetkazishda fikr egasini saqlang. O‘tgan paytdagi xabarni qayta aytganda zamon ko‘pincha orqaga siljiydi, lekin hali ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lgan gap uchun bu har doim majburiy emas. Reported question ichida oddiy darak tartibi bo‘ladi: asked where I lived, «where did I live» emas.
entries.explanationEn: Attribute the original speaker when reporting a statement. Backshift is common after a past reporting verb but is not always required for a statement that remains true. Reported questions use statement word order.

examples.en: The tutor said that the task was optional.
examples.uz: Ustoz topshiriq ixtiyoriy ekanini aytdi.

examples.en: She asked where I had found the example.

examples.uz: Mina charchaganini aytdi.

examples.en: He told me that he had finished.

examples.uz: U qayerda yashashimni so‘radi.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 16: Verb + verb patterns
entries.explanationUz: Ikkinchi fe’lning shakli birinchi fe’lga bog‘liq: enjoy doing, decide to do. Oddiy predlogdan keyin odatda -ing keladi; look forward to birikmasida to predlog bo‘lgani uchun doing ishlatiladi. Remember to do — qilishni unutmaslik, remember doing — oldin qilganini eslash.
entries.explanationEn: Learn verb patterns as units: enjoy doing, decide to do. A preposition is normally followed by -ing; to in look forward to is a preposition. Remember to do concerns a task; remember doing concerns a memory.

examples.uz: Qoralamamni saqlashni unutmadim.

examples.en: I remember saving the draft yesterday.
examples.uz: Kecha qoralamani saqlaganim esimda.

examples.uz: Men hikoya o‘qishni yoqtiraman.

examples.en: She decided to leave early.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 17: Likelihood based on conditions 1
entries.explanationUz: Shartli gapda if qismi shartni, ikkinchi qism natijani beradi. Zero conditional odat yoki umumiy bog‘lanish uchun, first conditional real kelajak imkoniyati uchun, second conditional tasavvur yoki ehtimoli past holat uchun ishlatiladi. Natijada faqat will emas, may yoki might ham kelishi mumkin.
entries.explanationEn: A conditional links a condition and a result. Zero conditionals can express general patterns, first conditionals real future possibilities, and second conditionals imagined or less likely situations. Result clauses can use modals such as may or might as well as will.

examples.en: If I revise regularly, I remember more.
examples.uz: Muntazam takrorlasam, ko‘proq eslab qolaman.

examples.en: If the library is open, I will study there.
examples.uz: Kutubxona ochiq bo‘lsa, u yerda o‘qiyman.

examples.en: If I had more free time, I would join the discussion.
examples.uz: Bo‘sh vaqtim ko‘proq bo‘lganida, muhokamaga qo‘shilardim.

examples.en: If water freezes, it expands.
examples.uz: Suv muzlasa, hajmi ortadi. Bu — umumiy holat.

examples.en: If I do not sleep enough, I feel tired.
examples.uz: Yetarli uxlamasam, charchoq sezaman.

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
examples.uz: Ertaga yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 18: Likelihood based on conditions 2
entries.explanationUz: Third conditional bo‘lmagan o‘tgan voqeani tasavvur qiladi: if + had + V3, would have + V3. Mixed conditionalda shart va natijaning vaqti boshqa-boshqa bo‘lishi mumkin. Avval «qachon?» deb ikkala qismning vaqtini aniqlang, so‘ng qolipni tanlang.
entries.explanationEn: The third conditional imagines an unreal past situation and result. Mixed conditionals connect different times, such as an unreal past choice and a present consequence. Identify the time of each clause before choosing the forms.

examples.en: If I had checked the source, I would have noticed the date.
examples.uz: Manbani tekshirganimda, sanani payqagan bo‘lardim.

examples.en: If I had slept earlier, I would feel more alert now.
examples.uz: Ertaroq uxlaganimda, hozir o‘zimni tetikroq his qilardim.

examples.en: I wish I had kept my first draft.
examples.uz: Birinchi qoralamamni saqlab qolganimda edi.

examples.en: If I had more time, I would read more.
examples.uz: Vaqtim ko‘proq bo‘lganida, ko‘proq kitob o‘qirdim.

examples.en: If I were you, I would ask the teacher.
examples.uz: Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lganimda, ustozdan so‘rardim.

examples.en: She would travel more if tickets were cheaper.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 19: Prepositions
entries.explanationUz: Predlogni ko‘pincha oldidagi fe’l, sifat yoki ot bilan birga o‘rganish kerak: depend on, interested in. O‘zbekcha qo‘shimchani inglizchaga bir xil predlog qilib ko‘chirmang. Discuss odatda to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri to‘ldiruvchi oladi: discuss the problem; explain esa odam bilan kelganda explain it to me bo‘ladi.
entries.explanationEn: Learn dependent prepositions with their verb, adjective or noun. Do not translate an Uzbek case ending into one fixed English preposition. Discuss normally takes a direct object; explain can take to + person.

examples.en: The answer depends on the context.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 20: Relative clauses
entries.explanationUz: Defining relative clause qaysi odam yoki narsa ekanini aniqlaydi; non-defining esa allaqachon aniq narsaga qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beradi va yozuvda vergul bilan ajratiladi. Non-definingda that odatda ishlatilmaydi. Relative pronoun egani bildirsa, yana he/she/it qo‘shmang.
entries.explanationEn: A defining relative clause identifies its referent; a non-defining clause adds information about an already identifiable referent and is set off by commas. That is not normally used in non-defining clauses. Do not repeat a subject pronoun already represented by the relative pronoun.

examples.en: The student who asked the question stayed after class.
examples.uz: Savol bergan o‘quvchi darsdan keyin qoldi.

examples.en: My notebook, which I bought last week, is already full.
examples.uz: O‘tgan hafta sotib olgan daftarim allaqachon to‘ldi.

examples.uz: Men tavsiya qilgan maqola internetda mavjud.

examples.uz: Men olib turgan kitob foydali.

examples.en: This is the place where we met.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 21: Ways of organising texts
entries.explanationUz: O‘quvchi tanigan fikrdan boshlang va keyin yangi ma’lumotni bering. Keyingi gap shu yangi ma’lumotni rivojlantirsa, paragraf ravon bo‘ladi. Introductory it aniq bir otga qaytishi shart emas: It is useful to compare... . Ellipsis faqat tushirib qoldirilgan qism oson tiklansa foydali.
entries.explanationEn: Move from information the reader already knows to new information, then develop that new point. Introductory it need not refer to a noun. Leave repeated words out only when the intended meaning stays clear.

examples.uz: Ikki tushuntirishni solishtirish foydali.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 22: The passive
entries.explanationUz: Passive natija yoki ta’sir ko‘rgan narsani oldinga chiqaradi: be + V3. Zamon be qismida saqlanadi. Have something done odatda ishni boshqaga qildirishni bildiradi. Reporting passive da’vo egasini yashirib yubormasligi kerak: kim kutayotgani yoki ishongani muhim bo‘lsa, manbani ayting.
entries.explanationEn: The passive foregrounds what happens to something: be + past participle. The form of be carries the tense. Have something done often describes arranging for someone else to do a task. Keep the source of a reported claim clear when it matters.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 23: Linking ideas
entries.explanationUz: Bog‘lovchini ma’nosi va undan keyingi tuzilma bilan tanlang. Although dan keyin ega va fe’l, despite dan keyin ot yoki -ing kelishi mumkin. However odatda ikkita mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan ulash uchun yetmaydi. Sababni because bilan, natijani therefore bilan ko‘rsatish mumkin.
entries.explanationEn: Choose a linker for its meaning and grammar. Although takes a clause; despite takes a noun phrase or -ing form. However alone does not license a comma splice between independent clauses. Distinguish a reason introduced by because from a result introduced by therefore.

examples.en: Although the text was difficult, I understood the main point.
examples.uz: Matn qiyin bo‘lsa ham, asosiy fikrni tushundim.

examples.en: Despite the difficulty, I completed the task.
examples.uz: Qiyinchilikka qaramay, topshiriqni tugatdim.

examples.en: The source was unclear; therefore, I checked another reference.
examples.uz: Manba noaniq edi; shuning uchun boshqa manbani tekshirdim.

examples.en: I stayed home because I was ill.
examples.uz: Kasal bo‘lganim uchun uyda qoldim.

examples.en: Although it was cold, we went outside.
examples.uz: Sovuq bo‘lsa ham, tashqariga chiqdik.

examples.en: The bus was late, so I walked.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 24: Showing your position in a text
aliases: cambridge showing your position in a text
entries.explanationUz: Fikringizni aniq ayting, lekin dalildan kuchliroq ishonch bildirmang. May, appears va suggests ehtiyotkor xulosa uchun yordam beradi; har bir gapni esa ortiqcha yumshatish shart emas. Academic yozuvda I ni mutlaqo taqiqlash to‘g‘ri emas: vazifa va uslubga mos bo‘lsa, o‘z pozitsiyangizni ko‘rsatishi mumkin.
entries.explanationEn: State a clear position while matching certainty to the evidence. May, appears and suggests can qualify a claim, but do not hedge every sentence needlessly. First-person language is not universally forbidden in academic writing; use it when appropriate to the task and style.

examples.en: I would argue that clear feedback helps learners improve.
examples.uz: Menimcha, aniq fikr-mulohaza o‘quvchilarning rivojlanishiga yordam beradi.

examples.en: The results suggest that further practice may help.
examples.uz: Natijalar qo‘shimcha mashq yordam berishi mumkinligini ko‘rsatadi.

examples.en: This conclusion applies to the group studied.
examples.uz: Bu xulosa o‘rganilgan guruhga tegishli.

examples.en: I believe cities should invest more in reliable buses.
examples.uz: Menimcha, shaharlar ishonchli avtobus qatnoviga ko‘proq mablag‘ ajratishi kerak.

examples.en: Frequent services reduce the time passengers spend waiting.
examples.uz: Tez-tez qatnaydigan avtobuslar yo‘lovchining kutish vaqtini kamaytiradi.

examples.en: This is especially useful for people who start work early.
examples.uz: Bu ayniqsa ishni erta boshlaydiganlar uchun foydali.

entries.title: Cambridge study guide · Unit 25: Nominalisation in written English
entries.explanationUz: Nominalisationda harakat yoki sifat ot orqali ifodalanadi: improve → improvement. Bu oldingi fikrni ixcham bog‘lashga yordam beradi, ammo avtomatik yuqori band bermaydi. Kim nima qilgani yo‘qolib qolmasin. The team improved the system → The team’s improvement of the system: bajaruvchi va ma’no saqlangan.
entries.explanationEn: Nominalisation expresses an action or quality through a noun, such as improve → improvement. It can connect ideas concisely, but it does not automatically raise an IELTS band. Preserve the agent and meaning, and avoid unnecessary complexity.

examples.en: Sales increased. The increase continued for two months.
examples.uz: Sotuv hajmi oshdi. O‘sish ikki oy davom etdi.

examples.en: The team improved the system. The team’s improvement of the system reduced waiting times.
examples.uz: Jamoa tizimni yaxshiladi. Jamoaning tizimni yaxshilashi kutish vaqtini qisqartirdi.

examples.en: The proposal was rejected. Its rejection surprised the committee.
examples.uz: Taklif rad etildi. Uning rad etilishi qo‘mitani hayratda qoldirdi.

examples.en: Costs fell. The reduction made the course more affordable.
examples.uz: Xarajatlar kamaydi. Bu kamayish kursni arzonroq qildi.

examples.en: The students participated actively. Their participation improved the discussion.
examples.uz: O‘quvchilar faol qatnashdi. Ularning ishtiroki muhokamani yaxshiladi.

examples.en: The class decided to continue. This decision pleased the tutor.
examples.uz: Sinf davom etishga qaror qildi. Bu qaror ustozni xursand qildi.

entries.tipUz: Shaklni tanlashdan oldin ma’no, vaqt va kontekstni tekshiring. Misollar yangi tuzilgan yoki RIWI’ning oldingi original kutubxonasidan olingan; kitob mashqlarining javob kaliti emas.
entries.tipEn: Check meaning, time and context before choosing a form. These are our original teaching examples, not the book’s exercise answer key.
entries.practiceUz: Uch misoldan bittasini o‘zingizga moslab qayta yozing. Nima uchun shu shaklni tanlaganingizni bir jumlada izohlang.
entries.practiceEn: Adapt one of the examples to your own situation and explain your grammar choice in one sentence.

source.book: Cambridge Grammar for IELTS with answers, Hopkins with Cullen, 2007
